title: tc-search-history
description:
Recent and saved searches – tabs with counts, a filter, searches grouped by day with scope chips, result counts and
times, and Run again, a save star and Remove with Undo on each.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

searches.description: The searches, any order; shown newest first. Saving and removing change it unless their events are prevented

tab.description: The tab shown. Changed by the user unless a tc-tab-change listener calls preventDefault()

now.description: The time now, epoch ms; by default the element's own clock

locale.description: The language for times and numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

query.description: The query as typed, or a builder query in words

scopes.description: Where it searched or how: "Files", "AI mode", "Contents"
